pre_execution_resource_amendment.reason: The first sbatch request was rejected before a job was created because marlowe-m000151-pm06 was no longer a valid association for the submitting user.

objective: Select a fair one-sided update and dense-materialization implementation on development-only seeds before freezing a new E3 confirmation.

original_drag_factor.role: frozen E3 one-sided implementation with internal vector allocation

original_drag_materialize_alloc.role: exact frozen E3 drag-plus-materialization implementation, including dense output allocation

original_drag_materialize_out.role: original one-sided update followed by MKL materialization into caller-owned output

fair_drag_factor.role: caller-workspace row-major and SIMD one-sided update candidate

fair_drag_materialize_mkl_out.role: fair update followed by single-thread MKL materialization into caller-owned output

fair_drag_materialize_candidate.role: fair update followed by the retained contiguous-dot materialization candidate into caller-owned output

timing_order: Every repetition contains every path once. The seven-path order is cyclically rotated by (seed + width_index + repetition) modulo seven, so each path occupies every timing position exactly three times.
state_preparation: All mutable input cloning, caller-owned update workspace creation, and caller-owned dense output creation occur before each timed interval.
steady_state_representation_boundary: The dense metric path begins from stored (L, Aw); drag paths begin from stored (L, Vb, Vc). Initial factor solves, initial dense materialization, and conversion between these persistent representations are excluded. This is a steady-state representation comparison, not a same-input kernel dispatcher benchmark.
correctness_reference: Fresh FP64 Cholesky of G+zz^T, fresh triangular solves for B and C, and their dense product.

selection_rule.eligibility: Every retained path must pass the relative-error tolerance in every development cell.
selection_rule.update_candidate: Select fair_drag_factor over original_drag_factor only if the geometric mean of within-seed median time ratios fair/original across all development cells is at most 0.98 and the median ratio in no rank-width cell exceeds 1.02; otherwise retain the original update.
selection_rule.materialization_candidates: Evaluate all-MKL and the family custom-if-p<=T-else-MKL for every tested T. A custom family is eligible only if its geometric-mean within-seed total-path ratio to all-MKL is at most 0.95 and its median ratio in no rank-width cell exceeds 1.02. Select the eligible family with the smallest geometric mean; ties and no eligible custom family select all-MKL.
selection_rule.no_confirmation_tuning: The selected eligible implementation is frozen before any reserved confirmation seed is evaluated.

stopping_rule: Run every declared rank, width, seed, path, warmup, and timing repetition. Do not filter or rerun based on development outcomes.
